# GUI-Bee $\textcircled { \scriptsize { \cdot } } \textcircled { \scriptsize { \cdot } } \textcircled { \scriptsize { \cdot } }$ : Align GUI Action Grounding toNovel Environmentsva Autonomous Exploration

Yue Fan 1, Handong Zhao ³, Ruiyi Zhang ³, Yu Shen ³, Xin Eric Wang \*1,2, Gang Wu \*3 1 UC Santa Cruz ‘² UC Santa Barbara ³ Adobe Research yfan71@ucsc.edu; ericxwang@ucsb.edu; {hazhao,ruizhang, shenyu, gawu} @adobe.com

![](images/0e4e61097343660884b81dd7299a0eaffbb364de0b7d5f8e5cb24134e5b2003d.jpg)  
Figure 1: We align GUI grounding models from prior works to novel environments. Our proposed alignment process on the top right includes first exploring the specific novel environment with the GUI-Bee agent to generate the exploration graph and then fine-tuning the model with the data from the exploration graph. In the inference example at the botom, the models encounter a query requiring knowledge of an environment-specific action outcome, which highlights the importance of the proposed alignment process.
